AddTagsBatch.description_en: Call AddTagsBatch to add tags to multiple Database File System (DBFS) instances in a single batch operation. This operation can add new tags or replace existing tags
AddTagsBatch.description_zh: 调用AddTagsBatch为多个数据库文件系统实例批量添加标签，可能存在新增标签与替换标签

ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Applies an automatic snapshot policy to one or more database file systems (DBFS)
ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 为一个或多个数据库文件系统设置自动快照策略

AttachDbfs.description_en: Call the AttachDbfs operation to attach a pay-as-you-go database file system to an ECS instance. The ECS instance and the database file system must be in the same zone
AttachDbfs.description_zh: 调用AttachDbfs为一台ECS实例挂载一个按量付费的数据库文件系统。ECS实例和数据库文件系统必须在同一个可用区内

CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Cancels the automatic snapshot policy for one or more database file systems
CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 取消一个或多个数据库文件系统的自动快照策略

CreateAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Create an automatic snapshot policy in a specified region. An automatic snapshot policy periodically creates snapshot backups for database file systems
CreateAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 在指定地域下创建一条自动快照策略。自动快照策略可以周期性地为数据库文件系统创建快照备份数据

CreateDbfs.description_en: Call CreateDbfs to create a pay-as-you-go Database File System (DBFS)
CreateDbfs.description_zh: 调用CreateDbfs创建一个按量付费的数据库文件系统

CreateServiceLinkedRole.description_en: Call CreateServiceLinkedRole to create a service-linked role that DBFS uses to manage dependent cloud resources
CreateServiceLinkedRole.description_zh: 调用CreateServiceLinkedRole创建服务关联角色，用于DBFS操作其它依赖的云资源

CreateSnapshot.description_en: Call CreateSnapshot to create a snapshot for a database file system
CreateSnapshot.description_zh: 调用CreateSnapshot给一个数据库文件系统创建快照

DeleteAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Deletes an automatic snapshot policy. File systems that use this policy automatically stop applying it after deletion
DeleteAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 删除一条自动快照策略。删除后，已经设置了该自动快照策略的文件系统将自动取消策略

DeleteDbfs.description_en: The DeleteDbfs operation releases a pay-as-you-go database file system
DeleteDbfs.description_zh: 调用DeleteDbfs释放一个按量付费的数据库文件系统

DeleteSnapshot.description_en: Call DeleteSnapshot to delete one or more DBFS snapshots
DeleteSnapshot.description_zh: 调用DeleteSnapshot删除一个或多个数据库文件系统的快照

DeleteTagsBatch.description_en: Call DeleteTagsBatch to remove tags from multiple Database File System (DBFS) instances
DeleteTagsBatch.description_zh: 调用DeleteTagsBatch批量删除多个数据库文件系统实例的标签

DescribeDbfsSpecifications.description_en: Call DescribeDbfsSpecifications to query DBFS specifications

DescribeInstanceTypes.description_en: Queries the instance types supported by DBFS
DescribeInstanceTypes.description_zh: 调用DescribeInstanceTypes查询DBFS支持的实例规格列表

DetachDbfs.description_en: Call DetachDbfs to detach a pay-as-you-go DBFS from an ECS instance
DetachDbfs.description_zh: 调用DetachDbfs从一台ECS实例上卸载一个按量付费的数据库文件系统

GetAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Queries the details of a single automatic snapshot policy
GetAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 查询单个自动快照策略

GetDbfs.description_en: Call GetDbfs to retrieve details about a Database File System (DBFS)
GetDbfs.description_zh: 调用GetDbfs查询数据库文件系统详细信息

GetServiceLinkedRole.description_en: You can call GetServiceLinkedRole to check whether a service-linked role has been created
GetServiceLinkedRole.description_zh: 调用GetServiceLinkedRole查询用户是否已经创建过服务关联角色

GetSnapshotLink.description_en: Retrieves the snapshot chain for a Database File System (DBFS). A snapshot chain is a sequence that includes all snapshots associated with a DBFS instance. Each file system has exactly one snapshot chain
GetSnapshotLink.description_zh: 查询数据库文件系统快照链。快照链是一个数据库文件系统所有快照组成的关系链，一个文件系统对应一条快照链

ListAutoSnapshotPolicies.description_en: List all automatic snapshot policies that you created in a region and that match your query conditions
ListAutoSnapshotPolicies.description_zh: 查询您在某个地域下，所有已创建的符合查询条件的自动快照策略

ListAutoSnapshotPolicyAppliedDbfs.description_en: Retrieves a list of Database File System (DBFS) instances that have a specific automatic snapshot policy applied
ListAutoSnapshotPolicyAppliedDbfs.description_zh: 查询所有已设置该自动快照策略的数据库文件系统列表

ListAutoSnapshotPolicyUnappliedDbfs.description_en: Lists all DBFS instances in a region without an automatic snapshot policy applied and that match your query criteria
ListAutoSnapshotPolicyUnappliedDbfs.description_zh: 查询您在某个地域下，所有已创建的符合查询条件的未设置自动快照策略的数据库文件系统

ListDbfs.description_en: Call ListDbfs to query the database file systems you have created
ListDbfs.description_zh: 调用ListDbfs查询您已经创建的数据库文件系统列表

ListDbfsAttachableEcsInstances.description_en: Call ListDbfsAttachableEcsInstances to query the list of ECS instances that can be attached to a DBFS file system
ListDbfsAttachableEcsInstances.description_zh: 调用ListDbfsAttachableEcsInstances查询数据库文件系统可挂载的ECS实例列表

ListDbfsAttachedEcsInstances.description_en: You can call the ListDbfsAttachedEcsInstances operation to query the ECS instances on which a DBFS is mounted
ListDbfsAttachedEcsInstances.description_zh: 调用ListDbfsAttachedEcsInstances查询数据库文件系统已挂载的ECS实例列表

ListSnapshot.description_en: Call ListSnapshot to query user-created DBFS snapshots
ListSnapshot.description_zh: 调用ListSnapshot查询用户创建的数据库文件系统快照列表

ListSnapshotLinks.description_en: Lists the snapshot chains in a region that match your criteria
ListSnapshotLinks.description_zh: 查询某个地域下满足条件的快照链

ListTagKeys.description_en: Call ListTagKeys to query all existing tag keys
ListTagKeys.description_zh: 调用ListTagKeys查询用户创建的所有标签键

ListTagValues.description_en: Call ListTagValues to retrieve all values associated with a specific tag key
ListTagValues.description_zh: 调用ListTagValues查询标签键下的所有标签值

ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Modifies an automatic snapshot policy. After you modify the policy, all DBFS file systems that use this policy immediately apply the updated settings
ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 修改一条自动快照策略。修改自动快照策略后，之前已设置该策略的数据库文件系统随即执行修改后的自动快照策略

ModifySnapshotAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a snapshot
ModifySnapshotAttribute.description_zh: 修改一份快照的名称、描述

RenameDbfs.description_zh: 调用RenameDbfs重命名一个数据库文件系统

ResizeDbfs.description_en: Call ResizeDbfs to resize a DBFS (database file system)
ResizeDbfs.description_zh: 调用ResizeDbfs扩容一个数据库文件系统

TagDbfs.description_en: Call TagDbfs to assign tags to a DBFS (database file system)
TagDbfs.description_zh: 调用TagDbfs为一个数据库文件系统设置标签

UpdateDbfs.description_en: Update the instance type and scenario of a Database File System (DBFS) instance
UpdateDbfs.description_zh: 修改一个数据库文件系统的实例规格和使用场景
